name: 34772 · Saint Cloud, FL
findings: ZIP 34772 (Saint Cloud) has 65 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (26%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 34772 (Saint Cloud) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 34772 (Saint Cloud) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 45% of the typical level).
